title: Current holdings, at-birth counts and all fair orders
claim: Test the seven archived repairs in order, then establish a present decision or bounded-radius obstruction on the two starts, then test any positive reading against ordinary growth outside identification.
standard_statement: Test intrinsic recognition of viable events and the effect of weak fairness before or after strict priority in an asynchronous incidence construction.

attained_result: On either registered seven-knot source the full physical stage recovers the ordinary births and their immutable counts in every maximal order of the least-unfinished-layer rule. No uniform ordinary radius can force complete growth on either source under weak fairness after strict global joins-first, using only ordinary birth actions.
